executive_view.headline: 基础设施投入加速，但六家公司的资本配置并不相同
executive_view.summary: 谷歌、微软、Meta 与 Amazon 的现金资本开支占收入比例均高于五年窗口的首年。英伟达的外部技术与股权安排需要单独观察；Apple 则仍将较多现金用于股东回报。投入规模不能直接说明项目回报。

sections.title: 从研发平台延伸到外部技术与股权
sections.summary: FY2026 非上市股权证券购买为 175.02 亿美元；另向 Groq 许可安排支付 130 亿美元。后者没有购入 Groq 的客户合同、现有产品或股权，不能将它写成收购 Groq 公司。
sections.view: 资本开支小于云平台，不等于 AI 投入较低；它在价值链中的位置不同。
sections.watch: 若外部股权和技术安排继续扩大，应进一步检查减值、现金回收和产品落地，而不只看收入增长。

sections.title: 资本开支开始超过回购
sections.summary: FY2025 技术基础设施是资本开支的主要方向。现金资本开支持续上升，回购现金额从 FY2024 回落；研发费用也继续增长。
sections.view: 资本配置的边际方向转向内部基础设施，但披露不足以把基础设施金额全部标为 AI。
sections.watch: 如果资本开支占收入比例下降、现金流继续增长，这种现金占用压力会减轻。

sections.title: 并购高点之后，现金投入转向基础设施
sections.summary: FY2024 的并购及其他资产购买出现高点；最新两年固定资产现金新增明显上升。FY2024 年报已说明云增长和 AI 基础设施是资本开支驱动。
sections.view: 并购是离散交易，基础设施扩张则可能带来持续折旧和维护支出；二者不能当成相同增长曲线外推。
sections.watch: 需把未来现金资本开支、融资租赁新增与 Azure 变现一起观察；本报告没有估计 AI 项目的独立回报率。

sections.title: 基础设施与研发同时扩张
sections.summary: FY2025 公司以费用口径描述的投入中，82% 属于应用家族，18% 属于 Reality Labs。这不是资本开支分布，更不是 AI 与非 AI 的现金比例。
sections.view: AI 投入服务于推荐、广告及新产品，不能直接视作对外出售算力的业务；现金支出上升不自动对应独立 AI 收入。
sections.watch: 需要观察广告变现能否持续覆盖资本支出与后续折旧；股权投资的回报应单独评估。

sections.title: 从履约扩张转向更大的技术基础设施投入
sections.summary: FY2025 年报将净现金资本开支主要归于技术基础设施及履约网络扩容，其中技术基础设施多数支持 AWS 增长；并未给出完整 AWS／零售／AI 百分比分拆。
sections.view: 最直接的财务变化是资本开支消耗了更多经营现金流；技术与基础设施费用不能再作为纯研发与之相加。
sections.watch: 若经营现金流追上资本开支增长，资本支出对内部现金的占用可能减轻；目前不能用全部资本开支推算 AI 收入或 ROI。

sections.title: 研发增加，现金配置仍偏向股东回报
sections.summary: FY2025 研发费用增加主要来自人员及基础设施相关成本。回购和股息现金仍显著高于固定资产购置现金。
sections.view: 与自建云基础设施的平台相比，Apple 的投入更难由固定资产现金支出概括；低资本开支不证明技术投入不足。
sections.watch: 若未来直接持有的基础设施或外部技术采购显著增加，资本配置结构可能改变。

methodology: 金额统一为美元；页面以十亿美元展示，底层保留百万美元原值。历史现金流出按正数展示；负的现金流余量保留负号。
每家公司各取最近五个已披露完整财年。微软截至六月、英伟达截至一月，不能把同一横向位置叫作同一自然年。主图横轴按真实财年结束日期定位。
现金资本开支采用各公司报告口径；Amazon 为固定资产购买减出售及激励，Meta 采用公司 FCF 调节表口径，NVIDIA 包含无形资产。主图不含非现金融资租赁新增。
Meta FY2023：旧报表固定资产购置 27,266 减回款 221，等于新报表及 FCF 调节口径 27,045 百万美元；FY2021–FY2022 同样用净额衔接。
研发属于损益费用，已影响经营现金流，且可能含股票薪酬与折旧。因此不与现金资本开支堆叠成总投资或重复扣减现金流。Amazon 的技术与基础设施费用单列，不等同于研发。
并购／无形资产和非上市投资的披露范围不一致。Amazon 合并披露并购、非上市投资及其他净额；Apple 未拆分；Microsoft 战略股权现金支出未完整单列。未披露不等于零。
Treasury 等日常证券购买不等于战略投资。回购、股息是股东回报，不属于业务再投资；回购金额不等于股数净减少，也不能据此计算投资者总收益。
经营现金流减现金资本开支为本报告的统一现金余量。Meta 官方 FCF 还扣融资租赁本金，不能用主图现金余量冒充其官方 FCF。
公司整体资本开支不能全部贴上 AI 标签，业务方向无完整金额拆分时不画百分比分布。承诺、授权、交易总对价、账面估值与本期现金支出分别处理。
Microsoft FY2025–FY2026 数字来自 SEC 收录的全年业绩公告，注明未经审计；FY2022–FY2024 来自官方年报。其他公司使用 SEC 10-K。所有原始文件和提取行已保留本地副本。
本报告不是实时新闻监控，不纳入尚未结束的 FY2026／FY2027 投入预测；不能用于判断当前季度的支出速度。

evidence.content: In December 2025, we entered into a non‑exclusive license agreement with Groq, Inc., or Groq, for its language processing unit technology and hired certain Groq employees. Goodwill, primarily attributable to the workforce and future development of the licensed technology, was recorded in the Compute & Networking reporting unit. Total consideration consists of $13.0 billion paid at closing and $4 billion, inclusive of imputed interest, payable within one year included in Accrued and Other Current Liabilities on our Consolidated Balance Sheets. evidence.locator: raw/SRC-007.txt line 184; search phrase: The majority of our investments are directed toward developing our family of apps
evidence.content: The majority of our investments are directed toward developing our family of apps. In 2025, 82% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 18% were recognized in RL. Our FoA investments were $96.29 billion in 2025 and include expenses relating to headcount, data centers and technical infrastructure as part of our efforts to develop our apps and our advertising services. We are also making significant investments in our RL efforts, including developing virtual and augmented reality devices, software for social platforms, neural interfaces, and other foundational technologies. Our total RL investments were $21.40 billion in 2025 and include expenses relating to headcount and technology development across these efforts. These are fundamentally new technologies that we expect will evolve as the next computing platform develops, and many products may only be fully realized in the next decade. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when and how the next computing platform will develop, we expect our RL segment to continue to operate at a loss for the foreseeable future,

evidence.locator: raw/SRC-009.txt line 465; search phrase: Cash capital expenditures were $77.7 billion
evidence.content: Cash provided by (used in) investing activities corresponds with cash capital expenditures, including leasehold improvements, incentives received from property and equipment vendors, proceeds from asset sales, cash outlays for acquisitions, investments in other companies and intellectual property rights, and purchases, sales, and maturities of marketable securities. Cash provided by (used in) investing activities was $(94.3) billion and $(142.5) billion in 2024 and 2025, with the variability caused primarily by purchases, sales, and maturities of marketable securities and cash capital expenditures. Cash capital expenditures were $77.7 billion, and $128.3 billion in 2024 and 2025, which primarily reflect investments in technology infrastructure (the majority of which is to support AWS business growth) and in additional capacity to support our fulfillment network, both of which we expect to increase in 2026. We made cash payments, net of acquired cash, related to acquisition and other investment activity of $7.1 billion and $3.8 billion in 2024 and 2025, which primarily reflect investments in convertible notes from Anthropic, PBC (“Anthropic”), including $2.7 billion we invested in 2025.

evidence.locator: raw/SRC-009.txt line 548; search phrase: Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll
evidence.content: Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll and related expenses for employees involved in the research and development of new and existing products and services, development, design, and maintenance of our stores, curation and display of products and services made available in our online stores, and infrastructure costs. Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services.
